simple.meaning: אֲנַף (ʼănaph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the face.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

occurrences.englishText: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.

Then Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury, and the form of his appearance was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He spoke, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.
